evals.prompt: Fixture: a disposable Git repo has an unrelated staged README change; both commit and conventionalcommits skills are installed. Fix the off-by-one bug in app.py and finish the implementation task using the commit skill's default workflow. Leave the README for later.
evals.expected_output: Load conventionalcommits first, inspect cached and working diffs, make and verify the app.py fix, and proactively commit only that logical unit without a routine approval question. Include a Conventional Commit subject and explanatory why-body. Preserve the unrelated staged README and report the remaining index state.

evals.prompt: Propose commits for this diff: an API feature, its regression test, its usage docs, and an unrelated formatter change in another module. Do not commit yet.
evals.expected_output: Group the feature with its test/docs, separate unrelated formatting, and make no index/history changes.

evals.prompt: The commit skill is installed but conventionalcommits is unavailable. Commit the app.py change using the normal skill workflow.
evals.expected_output: Report the missing required companion before drafting/creating a commit, without silently applying a fallback or making the dependency optional.

evals.prompt: Commit my fix in a disposable repo whose pre-commit hook exits 1 and prints 'format check failed'.
evals.expected_output: Report or fix the actual failure, inspect any resulting changes, and never bypass the hook or claim a commit succeeded without evidence.
